steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The range is the difference between the largest and smallest values: range = maximum – minimum; it is affected by outliers. | Key Fact: The interquartile range (IQR) = Q3 – Q1; it measures the spread of the middle 50% of the data and is not affected by outliers. | Key Fact: The IQR is preferred over the range when the data contains outliers or is skewed, because it ignores extreme values. | Key Fact: The pth percentile is the value below which p% of the data falls; it can be read from a cumulative frequency curve.
